title: The impact of social support on quality of life in Chinese parents of children with autism spectrum disorder: the mediating role of resilience
keywords: parents of children with autism spectrum disorder
core_idea: Investigate whether resilience mediates the relationship between social support and quality of life among Chinese parents of children with autism spectrum disorder, using standardized measures (SSRS, CD-RISC, WHOQOL-BREF) and mediation analysis.
tldr: A study of 257 Chinese parents of children with ASD using validated scales and PROCESS mediation analysis to test if resilience explains the link between social support and quality of life.
